name: Silk Waves
summary: Follows the Silk Waves sky through the day and the year: near-black with the month's glow at night, soft month-tinted light by day, turning light and dark on its own.
preview_alt: Silk Waves at midday in October, in the main chat view: dark text over Silk Waves' amber day sky and its glowing ribbon, with light cards and an amber accent.
